clauses.title: Parties
clauses.text: This mutual non-disclosure agreement is made between the two parties identified in the signature block, each a party and together the parties.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: Confidential Information means any information disclosed by one party to the other, in any form, that is marked as confidential or that would reasonably be regarded as confidential given its nature and the circumstances of disclosure.

clauses.title: Confidentiality obligations
clauses.text: Each party shall keep the other party's Confidential Information strictly confidential, shall use it solely for the purpose of evaluating a potential business relationship, and shall protect it with at least the same care it applies to its own confidential information.

clauses.title: Permitted disclosures
clauses.text: A party may disclose Confidential Information to its employees, professional advisers, and affiliates who need to know it for the permitted purpose and who are bound by obligations at least as protective, and may disclose it where required by law, regulation, or a court of competent jurisdiction, provided it gives the other party prompt written notice where lawful.

clauses.title: Term
clauses.text: This agreement takes effect on the date of the last signature and continues for two (2) years unless terminated earlier in accordance with its terms.

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this agreement by giving thirty (30) days' written notice to the other party. Termination does not affect rights or obligations accrued before the termination date, and the confidentiality obligations survive for three (3) years after termination.

clauses.title: Return or destruction
clauses.text: On the other party's written request, each party shall promptly return or destroy all Confidential Information of that party in its possession or control and, if requested, certify the destruction in writing.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability
clauses.text: Each party's liability is capped at twelve months of fees.

clauses.title: Governing law
clauses.text: This agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales, and the courts of England and Wales have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising from it.

clauses.title: Notices
clauses.text: Notices under this agreement must be in writing and are effective when delivered to the registered office of the receiving party, marked for the attention of its legal counsel.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: This agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties regarding its subject matter, supersedes all prior discussions, and may only be amended in writing signed by both parties.

clauses.title: Payment terms
clauses.text: Customer shall pay all invoices within thirty (30) days of the invoice date.

clauses.title: Renewal
clauses.text: The subscription automatically renews for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term.

clauses.title: Liability
clauses.text: Each party's aggregate liability under this order form is capped at the fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this order form for a material breach that remains uncured thirty (30) days after written notice of the breach.

clauses.title: Governing law
clauses.text: This order form is governed by the laws of England and Wales.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: This order form, together with the terms it references, forms the entire agreement between the parties for the services described in it.
